description:
Create comprehensive benchmark suite comparing DataFrame platform performance.
This was deferred from the dataframe-performance Phase 9.3 work pending
completion of Modin, cuDF, and Dask adapters.

Current state:
- Basic profiling exists (execute_query_profiled, MemoryTracker)
- Cross-platform example exists: examples/dataframe/cross_platform_comparison.py
- Missing: Systematic benchmark suite with standardized comparisons

Goal: Generate reproducible performance comparisons across all DataFrame
platforms for blog posts and documentation.
